name: Platinum + Etoposide (CISplatin or CARBOplatin) for SCLC
histology: small cell lung cancer (small cell carcinoma; high-grade neuroendocrine)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic platinum plus etoposide backbone is NOT biomarker-gated. No predictive biomarker selects this regimen in SCLC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer v1.2027, Principles of Systemic Therapy (SCL-E).

lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) systemic therapy for limited-stage (curative-intent, with thoracic radiation) and extensive-stage SCLC

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: small cell lung cancer, limited-stage or extensive-stage
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, Principles of Systemic Therapy (SCL-E 1 of 6); lines 945 to 978

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, line 951 (Cisplatin 75 mg/m2 Day 1 and Etoposide 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3)

drugs.notes: PREFERRED PLATINUM (choose CISplatin OR CARBOplatin, not both). Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 951. CISplatin 75 mg/m2 IV day 1. Requires IV hydration and nephro-/oto-/neurotoxicity precautions (cisplatin; DeVita 12th ed. line 132304 hydration, line 16606 irreversible nephro-, neuro-, ototoxicities). Alternative cisplatin schedules are source-stated: 60 mg/m2 day 1 with etoposide 120 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 952), or 25 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 with etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 959).

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, line 953 (Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 Day 1 and Etoposide 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3)

drugs.notes: ALTERNATIVE PLATINUM (choose CARBOplatin OR CISplatin, not both). Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 953. CARBOplatin dosed by Calvert AUC target 5 to 6, day 1 (dosePerUnit is the target AUC = 5; source range is AUC 5 to 6). basis auc per ISMP/Calvert.

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: SCL-E 1 of 6, lines 951 and 953 (Etoposide 100 mg/m2 Days 1, 2, 3)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 951 and 953. Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1, 2, 3. With the cisplatin 60 mg/m2 variant, etoposide is 120 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 952).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (highly emetogenic)
premedications.notes: cisplatin-based platinum plus etoposide is highly emetogenic; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis before chemotherapy.

supportiveCare: Four cycles of cytotoxic chemotherapy are recommended (up to 6 cycles in selected extensive-stage patients based on response/tolerability). Source: SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E lines 947 and 962.
cisplatin: IV hydration and nephro-/oto-/neurotoxicity monitoring (magnesium repletion).
Limited-stage with concurrent thoracic RT: planned cycle length every 21 to 28 days; myeloid growth factors are not recommended during concurrent chemoradiation. Source: SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E line 948.

For IO-eligible EXTENSIVE-stage disease, standard of care adds immunotherapy to this platinum plus etoposide backbone (see sclc-atezolizumab or sclc-durvalumab); the platinum plus etoposide backbone alone remains appropriate for limited-stage disease and for IO-ineligible patients.

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) and magnesium before each cisplatin cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC or platelet nadir, or worsening renal function
doseModificationRules.text: Delay or reduce per clinical review; consider switching cisplatin to carboplatin for renal impairment or intolerance.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 73273 (four cycles of EP as the SCLC induction backbone); cisplatin toxicity/hydration lines 132304 and 16606

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, Primary or Adjuvant Therapy for Limited-Stage and Primary Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC (SCL-E 1 of 6); cisplatin 75 mg/m2 day 1 plus etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 951); carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 day 1 plus etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 (line 953); four cycles (lines 947, 962)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for SCLC (#12), the cytotoxic platinum plus etoposide backbone. CISplatin 75 mg/m2 day 1 (choose cisplatin OR carboplatin), CARBOplatin AUC 5 to 6 day 1, and Etoposide 100 mg/m2 days 1 to 3 are dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E (lines 951 and 953). cycleLengthDays 21 and cycles 4 are grounded to SCL-E (four cycles, lines 947 and 962; limited-stage concurrent-RT cycle length 21 to 28 days per line 948). ISMP tall-man applied (CISplatin, CARBOplatin). Not biomarker-gated. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
